import itertools, json
def transform(grid):
    g=tuple(map(tuple,grid))
    cols=sorted(palette(g)-{0})
    leftc=min(cols,key=lambda c: min(j for i,j in ofcolor(g,c)))
    rc=[c for c in cols if c!=leftc][0]
    allo=sorted(objects(g,True,False,True), key=lambda o:(uppermost(o),leftmost(o)))
    L=[o for o in allo if next(iter(o))[0]==leftc]
    R=[o for o in allo if next(iter(o))[0]==rc]
    # greedy min size-diff, tie-break scan order
    pairs=[]; remR=list(R)
    for lo in L:
        best=min(remR, key=lambda ro:(abs(len(lo)-len(ro)), remR.index(ro)))
        remR.remove(best); pairs.append((lo,best))
    pairs=sorted(pairs, key=lambda pr: len(pr[0])+len(pr[1]))
    def shp(o):
        inds=toindices(o); ui,uj=ulcorner(inds)
        return [[g[ui+i][uj+j] if (ui+i,uj+j) in inds else 0 for j in range(width(inds))] for i in range(height(inds))]
    shapes=[]
    for lo,ro in pairs:
        ls,rs=shp(lo),shp(ro)
        h=max(len(ls),len(rs)); gap=max(1,abs(len(ls)-len(rs)))
        ls=[[0]*len(ls[0]) for _ in range(h-len(ls))]+ls
        rs=[[0]*len(rs[0]) for _ in range(h-len(rs))]+rs
        w=len(ls[0])+gap+len(rs[0])
        pg=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
        for i in range(h):
            pg[i][:len(ls[0])]=ls[i]
            pg[i][len(ls[0])+gap:]=rs[i]
        shapes.append(pg)
    total=sum(len(s) for s in shapes)+len(shapes)-1
    out=[[0]*len(g[0]) for _ in range(len(g))]
    r=len(g)-total
    for k,s in enumerate(shapes):
        if k: r+=1
        for i,row in enumerate(s):
            for j,v in enumerate(row): out[r+i][j]=v
        r+=len(s)
    return out
